still_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Minecraft Java fluid texture sprite sheet, NOT a mockup. Create one square pixel-art animation atlas for a pale-yellow toxic liquid that floats above the player. EXACT layout: 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square frames, touching with NO padding, NO gutters, NO borders, NO labels or grid lines. Each frame is a true 16 by 16 logical-pixel texture enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels; the whole atlas is exactly 64 by 64 logical pixels enlarged to fill the square output. All sixteen tiles are successive animation frames of the SAME seamless repeating fluid surface, reading left to right then top to bottom. Slow silky drifting cloudy eddies, diffuse narrow wisps like suspended fine sulfur dust, liquid rather than gas. Soft, low-contrast, mostly muted pale straw/ivory yellow with very subtle desaturated yellow-green undertones. Pixel clusters of only 5-7 closely related flat colors, roughly #CBC99C #D7D4AE #E1DEBE #EAE6CD #F0ECD6. Very small transient flecks, no distinct circular bubbles. No dark outlines, NO rings, NO centered motifs, NO large blobs, no veins, no checkerboard, no luminous lattice, no embossed highlights or directional lighting. Each frame must tile seamlessly on all sides and all frames must keep the same average brightness. Subtle displacement between successive frames; last frame loops smoothly to first. Unlit orthographic flat texture filling every pixel; no perspective, no rendered world, no objects, no text. Opaque background. Restraint is crucial: from a distance it must read as a calm mysterious pale liquid surface, not repeated patterned wallpaper or cheese.
flow_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Minecraft Java flowing-fluid pixel texture animation atlas, not concept art or a scene. Create one square sprite atlas, EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows of 16 equal touching frames, no gaps, no grid lines, no text. Each frame represents exactly 32 by 32 logical pixels, enlarged with crisp square pixels; full atlas 128 by 128 logical pixels enlarged to fill output. Frames left-to-right then top-to-bottom show successive subtle phases of ONE pale-yellow upward-flowing toxic liquid. It belongs with a restrained cloudy pale-straw liquid surface: muted close colors #CBC99C #D7D4AE #E1DEBE #EAE6CD #F0ECD6, slight yellow-green sulfur undertone. Fine soft elongated whorls drift slowly upward, very low contrast and no strong regular stripes. A few soft flecks dissolve into the flow. Every frame seamless left/right and top/bottom, same average brightness, last frame returns to first. Preserve the impression of liquid with suspended dust, neither rock nor wood nor gas cloud. Each frame may use a 16 by 16 periodic motif repeated twice in both directions so cropped half-tiles remain seamless, but never create a central emblem. 5-7 closely related flat colors, no dark outlines, rings, big bubbles, large blobs, veins, bright foam, lattice, raised highlights, borders or checkerboard. Flat orthographic texture only, opaque throughout, no lighting, perspective, objects, landscape, labels. This will cover a huge upper sea seen from below: large shapes and strong contrasts are forbidden.
